contract.note: Assessing source quality, accuracy and coverage is an ordinary reading of research quality. The contract fairly allows substantive strengths to count against the emphatic criticism.

evidence.note: The independent audit identifies factual problems in a main source that carried into the same report. It was published before the cutoff.

reviews.rationale: The audit supports criticism of weak sourcing, factual errors and important omissions. It also finds substantial accuracy, relevant obscure information and coverage of most key points. The evidence supports research weaknesses but cuts against the claim's sweeping extent. All three items come from one independent assessment.
